figures.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(f.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(h.labor,0) labor_cents,COALESCE(a.spend,0) advertising_cents,COALESCE(p.procurement,0) committed_purchase_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0)-COALESCE(f.expense,0)-COALESCE(h.labor,0) operating_contribution_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key ORDER BY m.month_key

figures.title: 月度经营汇总：各来源独立汇总，再放进同一行（以 2025-01 为例）

stages.label: ① 处理前：2025-01 的各个来源，各自按自己的日期口径汇总（分）
stages.note: 销售按订单日期、费用按分录日期、人工按员工月份、采购按订单日期、广告按活动月份。

tables.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT item, amount_cents FROM (SELECT 1 n,'销售（净额）' item, COALESCE(s.net,0) amount_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key WHERE m.month_key='2025-01' UNION ALL SELECT 2,'毛利', COALESCE(s.gross,0) FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key WHERE m.month_key='2025-01' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'费用', COALESCE(f.expense,0) FROM m LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key WHERE m.month_key='2025-01' UNION ALL SELECT 4,'人工', COALESCE(h.labor,0) FROM m LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key WHERE m.month_key='2025-01' UNION ALL SELECT 5,'广告', COALESCE(a.spend,0) FROM m LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key WHERE m.month_key='2025-01' UNION ALL SELECT 6,'采购承诺', COALESCE(p.procurement,0) FROM m LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key WHERE m.month_key='2025-01') ORDER BY n
